# AbstractAgent

> Agent patterns (ReAct / CodeAct / MemAct) built on AbstractRuntime (durable effects + storage) and AbstractCore (tools + LLM integration).

This repository contains the `abstractagent` Python package.
Start with the docs in `docs/`, then follow the code pointers for implementation details.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Installation + quick start
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Map of all docs
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): Minimal usage + persistence example
- [Agents](docs/agents.md): Agent types + API
- [Tools](docs/tools.md): Default tools, allowlists, schema-only built-ins
- [Persistence](docs/persistence.md): Pause/resume across restarts
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): How logic/adapters/agents fit together (diagrams)
- [ReAct pipeline](docs/react-pipeline.md): ReAct workflow details

## Code entry points

- [Public API](src/abstractagent/__init__.py): Exported symbols
- [Agents package](src/abstractagent/agents/__init__.py): Agent factories + classes
- [BaseAgent](src/abstractagent/agents/base.py): start/step/resume/attach/save_state/get_ledger
- [ReAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/react_runtime.py): `create_react_workflow(...)`
- [CodeAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/codeact_runtime.py): `create_codeact_workflow(...)`
- [MemAct workflow](src/abstractagent/adapters/memact_runtime.py): `create_memact_workflow(...)`
- [Built-in tool schemas](src/abstractagent/logic/builtins.py): schema-only tools mapped to runtime effects
- [Default tools bundle](src/abstractagent/tools/__init__.py): `ALL_TOOLS`

## Tests

- [Test suite](tests/): `pytest` tests for workflows and agent behavior

## Optional

- [Manual demo](manual_agent_demo.py): Minimal local demo (requires a working provider)
- [LMStudio tool eval](src/abstractagent/scripts/lmstudio_tool_eval.py): Manual evaluation harness against a real model
